item_name: Cold Steel Recon Tanto Rubber Training Knife
item_short_desc: Cold Steel’s Recon Tanto Rubber Training Knife is made of a 7” Santoprene Rubber blade. This 11 ¾” knife is soft enough to prevent the likelihood of most bodily injury, and perfect for Solo Practicing, Training Drills, Demonstrations, and Airsoft and Paintball.
